About the Geaux Ride Thursday Night Community Ride group ride

A free Thursday night cruise through downtown Baton Rouge with lights and music. Bring your own bike or rent one from Geaux Ride. Family friendly. Street parking or the garage at 3rd and Main.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
